facts: About 94,000 people (2017 census), Fiji's most populous settlement
On a hilly peninsula in the southeast of Viti Levu
worth_knowing: In 1877 the capital moved here from Levuka, the main European colonial settlement, because of Levuka's restrictive geography. Suva is also Fiji's major port.
